headline: PHP2Shell CISA deadline tomorrow; DHS personnel data leak hits 41,000 workers; Linux kernel and VMware ESX flaws added to KEV

bullets.text: New: A hacker stole personnel data on about 41,000 Homeland Security employees, including CBP and ICE agents, some undercover. Japan Airlines also warned of a data breach as Japan deals with multiple cyber incidents, including GMO and So-net.
New: GitHub advisory CVE-2026-115893: Wasmtime's Cranelift backend on aarch64 can jump to an incorrect target on a large Wasm br_table instruction. Rated critical by the GitHub Advisory DB.

PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) rooted 25 servers and breached a U.S. government-affiliated network; China-linked actors are rooting firewalls. CISA's due date is tomorrow, 2026-10-29; fixes are in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35.

CISA added Linux kernel CVE-2026-46300 (missing variable initialization, due 2026-10-31) and Broadcom VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 (insufficient logging, due 2026-11-11) to KEV today. Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356 and Brotli CVE-2026-111497 are due 2026-11-10.
Volt Typhoon used its covert, ephemeral 'Silent Train' network to hide traffic in four zero-day exploitation campaigns, per The Hacker News, BleepingComputer and CyberScoop.

Attackers are targeting critical Oracle E-Business Suite RCE CVE-2026-101767 days after the patch, and the ShinyHunters-exploited PeopleSoft zero-day (CVE-2026-35273) turned out to be three chained flaws. CISA warns Node2Shell is being exploited.

actions: Update PHP to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 before CISA's 2026-10-29 deadline, including firewalls and appliances, and check exposed hosts.
Apply your distribution's kernel fix for CVE-2026-46300 before 2026-10-31, starting with multi-user and internet-facing Linux hosts.
Patch VMware ESX for CVE-2026-41709 per Broadcom's advisory and review ESX hosts for activity the logs may have missed.
If you run Wasmtime on aarch64, review GHSA-mghf-wjfp-p5xm (CVE-2026-115893) and upgrade to the fixed release it lists.
Apply Oracle's patches for E-Business Suite CVE-2026-101767 and PeopleSoft CVE-2026-35273, and patch Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356.
Hunt edge and network devices for Volt Typhoon 'Silent Train' infrastructure using the indicators in the published research.
